request.question: Is payroll down? Someone said it'll be fixed in 30 minutes, can you confirm the exact time?
request.answer: The payroll portal shows "SSO authentication failed" for employees in all regions. 1. Engineers in the identity team are investigating a configuration change made on 7 November 2026. 2. No restoration time has been published

documents.text:
## Workaround
Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox; they will be processed when the portal is back. Payroll itself runs on schedule; salaries are not affected.

## Updates
Updates are posted on the IT status page every two hours.
